text:
Anthony Duclair is on his ninth NHL team in his third season on Long Island, and he's scoring like a top-six winger in 13:39 a night: 7 goals in 24 games, with four in his last ten. Our log has him with three goals and an assist over his last five games. The heavy shot is real (93rd percentile) and so is the speed.

The finishing isn't built to last. Those 7 goals came on 3.5 expected goals, our measure of chance quality, and he's shooting 25% after 16% last season. The bigger concern runs the other way. The Islanders get under 46% of the 5-on-5 chance quality with him on the ice, about 7 points worse than when he sits, and Evolving-Hockey had opponents gaining 0.28 expected goals per 60 with him out there last season, bottom 1% of forwards. Some luck cuts in his favor too: New York has scored 5.2 fewer goals than its chances deserve with him on. Our numbers project about 18 goals. Watch the chances against.
headline: Anthony Duclair is finishing; the Islanders' chances aren't
